name: Letta
summary: Platform for stateful agents with memory, identity and the ability to learn over time (formerly MemGPT); terminal UI, App Server, desktop app and Agent SDK.
description: Current source lives in `letta-ai/letta-code`, now called the Letta Harness (formerly Letta Code; npm `@letta-ai/letta-code`), with a git-versioned memory filesystem (MemFS), skills, schedules and sleep-time subagents. The original `letta-ai/letta` repo (not archived) points there and keeps the retired V1 API server on an `archive` branch.
